88cc9b683ebeb0f8.column_purpose: Primary key identifying the account; referenced by loan, disp, trans, and order tables.

843ce015f912b1d7.column_purpose: Foreign key to district (district.col_001), the region where the account was opened.

16e170ac34f01b1a.column_purpose: Frequency of account statement issuance: POPLATEK MESICNE = monthly, POPLATEK TYDNE = weekly, POPLATEK PO OBRATU = after each transaction (Czech).

77337ec9b6df160e.column_purpose: Date the account was opened (1993-01-01 to 1997-12-29).

2d83786a793a6ab3.column_purpose: Primary key of the card; unique integer identifier for each issued card.

a3cf2d8a06bfee1a.column_purpose: Foreign key to disp (disposition), identifying the client's ownership relation to an account; one-to-one, so each card belongs to exactly one client on one account.

04bf058747b44f62.column_purpose: Card product type: 'classic' (standard card, 659), 'junior' (card for young clients, 145), 'gold' (premium card, 88).

5822f70aa5cd5f2b.column_purpose: Date the card was issued (1993-11-07 to 1998-12-29).

e972ab614d4a9781.column_purpose: Client gender: M = male, F = female.

7edc29a9a67b83e1.column_purpose: Client date of birth (range 1911-1987, consistent with birth dates, not transaction dates).

8b07c051aa5363eb.column_purpose: Foreign key to district table (district.col_001), identifying the district where the client lives; lookup values are Czech district names.

3eb7f044bce37634.column_purpose: Primary key of the disposition record; unique surrogate identifier (1-13690).

af6ed80079667c26.column_purpose: Foreign key to client (client.col_001), identifying the client attached to the account. One-to-one with the disposition row; also referenced by card.col_002, since a credit card is issued to a specific client on an account.

ce3c96629dd1d7cf.column_purpose: Foreign key to account (account.col_001), identifying the account the client is attached to. Many-to-one: an account can have multiple dispositions (owner plus disponent).

48e839ba80968a49.column_purpose: Disposition type: 'OWNER' (account holder, 4500 rows, one per account) or 'DISPONENT' (authorized additional user, 869 rows).

9ad7bcc2a99dc915.column_purpose: Primary key; numeric district identifier (1-77). Referenced by client, account and loan tables.

cf40970075dc06ef.column_purpose: Name of the district (Czech okres), e.g. 'Benesov', 'Brno - mesto', 'Jablonec n. Nisou'. Unique per row.

f2da9c2d3b2becc2.column_purpose: Region of the Czech Republic the district belongs to (8 values: north/south/east/west Bohemia, north/south Moravia, Prague, central Bohemia).

f66a85a37c6cc31a.column_purpose: Number of inhabitants of the district (range ~42,821 to 1,204,953; Prague is the max).

376e76c2c4febd29.column_purpose: Count of municipalities in the district with fewer than 500 inhabitants.

8d5f72e372e7d8a9.column_purpose: Count of municipalities with more than 10,000 inhabitants (0-5).

3612fe11be9caa6c.column_purpose: Number of cities in the district (1-11).

508456b6f3b3390b.column_purpose: Share of urban inhabitants, in percent (33.9-100.0).

2858aa6e97932bb9.column_purpose: Average monthly salary in the district, in CZK (range ~8,110-12,541).

5f8b30ca0548d7ab.column_purpose: Unemployment rate in 1995, in percent (0.2-7.3); one null present.

86ac25b033b24e10.column_purpose: Number of committed crimes in 1995 (818-85,677; Prague is the outlier max).

16d4a4f478f9622e.column_purpose: Owning account; references account.col_001 (one-to-one here, i.e. each account has at most one loan in this table).

d27f9a0f28a97861.column_purpose: Date the loan was granted (1993-07-05 to 1998-12-08).

35d733dd31c2f6b0.column_purpose: Loan duration in months; only values 12, 24, 36, 48, 60. The suggested join to district is spurious - the values are durations, not district codes.

942fe1f7fe94721e.column_purpose: Monthly repayment amount in CZK; consistent with amount/duration (e.g. 76080/12 = 6340).

0733e57a7a76273c.column_purpose: Loan repayment status: A = finished, paid; B = finished, not paid (defaulted); C = running, current; D = running, in arrears/debt. Exact wording is inferred from the standard PK'99 coding; the four-category contract-status reading (finished/running x good/bad) is strongly supported by the A-D distribution.

12054d41e40a3ba8.column_purpose: Primary key of the payment order; unique integer identifier.

21269737d82cef99.column_purpose: Owning account the payment order is charged to; references account.col_001 (many orders per account).

dbf8674f16d488e3.column_purpose: Two-letter code of the receiving bank (13 distinct codes, roughly uniform). Likely a Czech bank code; exact code-to-bank mapping not available, so individual codes unresolved.

f5c166ba1a3b0526.column_purpose: Account number of the beneficiary at the receiving bank (col_003). Nearly unique per order; no join target.

6104c30456b45568.column_purpose: Debited amount per payment, in the account currency (CZK); range 1–14,882, median ~2,596.

58bbaac72c62c62c.column_purpose: Payment purpose/symbol: SIPO = household/utility payment, UVER = loan repayment, POJISTNE = insurance, LEASING = leasing payment, empty = unspecified/other.

9f3f0c28878902a2.column_purpose: Owning account; references account.col_001 (many transactions per account).

847a1863593f3334.column_purpose: Transaction type in Czech: PRIJEM = credit/income, VYDAJ = debit/expense, VYBER = cash withdrawal.

780ef0b556887fb8.column_purpose: Operation mode in Czech: VYBER = cash withdrawal, VKLAD = cash deposit, PREVOD NA UCET = transfer to another account, PREVOD Z UCTU = transfer from another account, VYBER KARTOU = card withdrawal. Null when only 'type' applies.

6e5bd077909288ab.column_purpose: Account balance after the transaction in CZK; can be negative (overdraft).

c83795a39cc66d85.column_purpose: Transaction characterization in Czech: UROK = interest credited, SLUZBY = services/payment for statement, SIPO = household utilities, DUCHOD = pension, UVER = loan payment, SANKC. UROK = sanction interest, POJISTNE = insurance. Blank/null when not applicable.

64e32f07d46c1fec.column_purpose: Code of the counterparty bank for interbank transfers (two-letter codes); null for non-transfer transactions.

71921c6da20743e9.column_purpose: Counterparty account number for interbank transfers; null otherwise. 0 appears as a placeholder.
